summary: Immutep Ltd filed a Form 6-K quarterly activities report (Appendix 4C) for Q3 FY2026. The filing discloses that the independent data monitoring committee recommended discontinuation of the TACTI-004 Phase III trial after an interim futility analysis, and Immutep has halted enrollment and is winding down the study. This is an operational/clinical trial update, not a corporate transaction or special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is reported. The filing is a routine business update.
